test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Every students in the hostel decided to travel to Delhi to witness the Republic Day parade.
solution:
The correct answer is 4 i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this part of the sentence, the word "students" should be in the singular form "student" to agree with the singular subject "Every".
 
• The corrected part should read **'Every student in the hostel' **to make the sentence grammatically correct.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Every student in the hostel decided to travel to Delhi to witness the Republic Day parade.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The subject and verb must agree in number, meaning both need to be singular or both need to be plural.
 
• When a singular subject is followed by a phrase or clause that starts with words such as along with, besides, or as well as, the number of the subject does not change. Use a singular verb. For example: *The teacher, along with her students, is going on a trip.*
